description:
BrightEdge is an AI-powered SEO and content performance platform that enables marketers to discover opportunities, optimize content, and track rankings. Its analytics suite turns search data into actionable insights.

BrightEdge is an enterprise AEO and SEO platform for AI search. Grow visibility, traffic and revenue across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and more.

AI-driven content recommendations for SEO. Rank tracking for keywords and competitors. Site and page-level analytics dashboards. Opportunity discovery for organic growth.

howToUse.title: Request a Demo & Onboarding
howToUse.description: Visit BrightEdge and request a demo or contact sales. Upon onboarding, you'll get access to the platform and a guided setup.

howToUse.title: Set Up Your Website and Keywords
howToUse.description: Add your website and target keywords to the dashboard for monitoring and optimization.

howToUse.title: Analyze Opportunities
howToUse.description: Use the AI-powered analytics suite to discover ranking opportunities, content gaps, and competitor benchmarks.

howToUse.title: Optimize Content
howToUse.description: Follow BrightEdge’s AI-driven recommendations to improve on-page SEO, content relevance, and technical performance.

howToUse.title: Track and Report
howToUse.description: Monitor keyword rankings, site performance, and campaign impact using customizable dashboards and exportable reports.
